bio.text: Roxanne J. Persaud is a member of the New York State Senate representing District 19 in Brooklyn; according to her campaign website she was elected in November 2015 after serving in the State Assembly.
The site says she was born in Guyana, holds a B.S. and M.S. in Education Administration from Pace University, and lives in Canarsie.

It states that before becoming a legislator she worked in higher education administration and served as president of the 69th Precinct Community Council in Canarsie and as a member of Community Board 18.
